scope: Records needed by the series world-powers-daniel, seven-heads-of-the-beast, kings-north-and-south and daniel-time-prophecies that were missing from the data: League of Nations and United Nations (image of the wild beast), identities of the king of the north and king of the south in the time of the end (The Watchtower, May 2020), Augustus’ registration (Dan. 11:20), and start/end events of the 1,290 and 1,335 days.

events.title_en: Augustus sends out “an exactor” by ordering a registration
events.description_en: In 2 B.C.E. Augustus, the king of the north of Daniel 11:20, ordered a registration, or census, that included the province of Judea. Because of this decree Joseph and Mary traveled to Bethlehem, where Jesus was born.
events.description_ta: பொ.ச.மு. 2-ல் அகஸ்டஸ் ‘வரிவசூலிப்பவனை’ அனுப்பி, குடிமதிப்பு எழுதும்படி ஆணையிட்டார்.

sources.publication: Pay Attention to Daniel’s Prophecy! (dp) ch. 14
sources.title_en: The Two Kings Change Identities
sources.quote_en: In 2 B.C.E., Augustus sent out “an exactor” by ordering a registration, or census, probably so that he could learn the number of the population for purposes of taxation and military conscription.

events.title_en: Britain as “the king of the south”
events.description_en: By 1870 Britain had become the largest empire on earth; it filled the role of the king of the south of Daniel 11 until, during World War I, it was joined by the United States and the role passed to the Anglo-American World Power.
events.description_ta: இந்த உலகத்திலேயே மிகப் பெரிய சாம்ராஜ்யமாக 1870-ல் பிரிட்டன் உருவெடுத்தது. பிரிட்டன், 1917-வரை தென்திசை ராஜாவாக இருந்தது.

sources.title_en: “The King of the North” in the Time of the End
sources.quote_en: By 1870, Britain had become the largest empire on earth, and it had the most powerful military force.

sources.title_en: “The King of the North” in the Time of the End
sources.quote_en: And it filled the role of the king of the south well into World War I.

sources.title_en: Rival Kings in the Time of the End
sources.title_ta: கடைசி நாட்களில் எதிரும் புதிருமான இரண்டு ராஜாக்கள்
sources.quote_en: The king of the south is initially identified as Great Britain, but in 1917 is replaced by the Anglo-American World Power.

events.notes: English text of w20.05 par. 7 says “well into World War I”; the chart description and the Tamil text of the same paragraph give 1917.

events.title_en: German Empire established; “the king of the north” reappears
events.description_en: In 1871 Otto von Bismarck was instrumental in establishing the German Empire, with Prussian King Wilhelm I as its first emperor. The Watchtower (2020) identifies this as the reappearance of the king of the north of Daniel 11.
events.description_ta: அந்த வருஷத்தில், ஓட்டோ வான் பிஸ்மார்க் ஜெர்மனி சாம்ராஜ்யத்தை உருவாக்குவதில் முக்கியப் பங்கு வகித்தார். முதலாம் வில்ஹெல்ம் அதன் முதல் பேரரசராக ஆனார்.

sources.title_en: “The King of the North” in the Time of the End
sources.quote_en: In 1871, the year after Russell and his associates formed their Bible study group, the king of the north reappeared. That year Otto von Bismarck was instrumental in establishing the German Empire.

sources.title_en: Rival Kings in the Time of the End
sources.title_ta: கடைசி நாட்களில் எதிரும் புதிருமான இரண்டு ராஜாக்கள்
sources.quote_en: The king of the north reappears in 1871 as Germany.

events.title_en: Germany as “the king of the north”
events.description_en: From 1871 until 1945 Germany filled the role of the king of the north: the German Empire, whose army was “swept away” in World War I (Dan. 11:25-30a), and then Nazi Germany, which attacked God’s people in the 1930’s and during World War II (Dan. 11:30b, 31a).
events.description_ta: 1871-ல் ஜெர்மனி வடதிசை ராஜாவாக உருவெடுத்தது. ஜெர்மனி 1945 வரை வடதிசை ராஜாவாக இருந்தது.

sources.title_en: “The King of the North” in the Time of the End
sources.quote_en: In 1871, the year after Russell and his associates formed their Bible study group, the king of the north reappeared.

sources.title_en: “The King of the North” in the Time of the End
sources.quote_en: Then, in the 1930’s and especially during the second world war, the king of the north attacked God’s people without mercy.

sources.title_en: Rival Kings in the Time of the End
sources.title_ta: கடைசி நாட்களில் எதிரும் புதிருமான இரண்டு ராஜாக்கள்
sources.quote_en: The king of the north is identified as Germany until 1945.

events.notes: Pay Attention to Daniel’s Prophecy! (1999) ch. 15-16 listed “German Empire” (Dan. 11:27-30a) and “Hitler’s Third Reich” (Dan. 11:30b, 31) as successive kings of the north; The Watchtower, May 2020, applies Dan. 11:25-31 to Germany from 1871 to 1945.

events.title_en: League of Nations officially proposed; the 1,290 days begin
events.description_en: The League of Nations, the first form of “the disgusting thing that is causing desolation,” was officially proposed in January 1919. With this, both conditions of Daniel 12:11 were met, so the 1,290 days began in early 1919.

sources.publication: Pay Attention to Daniel’s Prophecy! (dp) ch. 17
sources.title_en: Identifying True Worshipers in the Time of the End
sources.quote_en: The League was officially proposed in January 1919. At that time, then, both conditions of Daniel 12:11 were met.

events.title_en: League of Nations comes into existence (“the wild beast . . . was”)
events.description_en: The League of Nations, promoted by Britain and the United States, existed from January 10, 1920, onward, with 63 nations participating at one time or another. Jehovah’s Witnesses identify it as the image of the wild beast of Revelation 13 and the scarlet-colored wild beast of Revelation 17.
events.description_ta: ஆம், 63 தேசங்கள் ஒரு சமயத்திலோ அல்லது வேறொரு சமயத்திலோ பங்கெடுத்தன; ஜனவரி 10, 1920 முதல் சர்வதேச சங்கமாக அது இருந்தது.

sources.publication: Revelation—Its Grand Climax At Hand! (re) ch. 34
sources.title_en: An Awesome Mystery Solved
sources.quote_en: Yes, it had existed as the League of Nations from January 10, 1920, onward, with 63 nations participating at one time or another.

sources.title_en: Rival Kings in the Time of the End
sources.title_ta: கடைசி நாட்களில் எதிரும் புதிருமான இரண்டு ராஜாக்கள்
sources.quote_en: In 1920, the League of Nations is founded and continues until the start of World War II.

sources.publication: Revelation—Its Grand Climax At Hand! (re) ch. 28
sources.title_en: Contending With Two Ferocious Beasts
sources.quote_en: The outworking of history identifies this image as the organization proposed, promoted, and supported by Britain and the United States and known initially as the League of Nations.

events.title_en: The League of Nations (the image of the wild beast)
events.description_en: The League of Nations “was” from 1920 until the start of World War II. When the Nazi dictator of Germany launched the war in September 1939, the League, having failed to keep peace, virtually plunged into an abyss of inactivity (“is not”).
events.description_ta: 1920-ல், சர்வதேச சங்கம் ஏற்படுத்தப்படுகிறது. இரண்டாம் உலகப் போர் ஆரம்பிக்கும்வரை அது செயல்படுகிறது.

sources.publication: Revelation—Its Grand Climax At Hand! (re) ch. 34
sources.title_en: An Awesome Mystery Solved
sources.quote_en: Yes, it had existed as the League of Nations from January 10, 1920, onward, with 63 nations participating at one time or another.

sources.publication: Revelation—Its Grand Climax At Hand! (re) ch. 34
sources.title_en: An Awesome Mystery Solved
sources.quote_en: In September 1939 the Nazi dictator of Germany launched World War II

sources.publication: Revelation—Its Grand Climax At Hand! (re) ch. 34
sources.title_en: An Awesome Mystery Solved
sources.quote_en: Having failed to keep peace in the world, the League of Nations virtually plunged into an abyss of inactivity.

sources.title_en: Rival Kings in the Time of the End
sources.title_ta: கடைசி நாட்களில் எதிரும் புதிருமான இரண்டு ராஜாக்கள்
sources.quote_en: In 1920, the League of Nations is founded and continues until the start of World War II.

events.notes: End taken as the start of World War II (September 1939), when, per re ch. 34, the League “virtually plunged into an abyss of inactivity”; by 1942 it had become “a has-been.”

events.title_en: Convention in May 1926; book Deliverance released; the 1,335 days end
events.title_ta: மே 1926-ல் நடந்த மாநாட்டில் விடுதலை என்ற ஆங்கில புத்தகம் வெளியிடப்பட்டது.
events.description_en: At the convention in May 1926, the book Deliverance was released, one of a series of new books to replace Studies in the Scriptures. Daniel’s Prophecy explains that the 1,335 days of Daniel 12:12 thus ended with the holy ones in a happy state.
events.description_ta: மே 1926-ல் நடந்த மாநாட்டில் விடுதலை என்ற ஆங்கில புத்தகம் வெளியிடப்பட்டது.

sources.publication: Pay Attention to Daniel’s Prophecy! (dp) ch. 17
sources.title_en: Identifying True Worshipers in the Time of the End
sources.quote_en: At the convention in May 1926, the book Deliverance was released.

events.title_en: United Nations Charter accepted: the scarlet-colored wild beast ascends out of the abyss
events.title_ta: சிவப்புநிற மூர்க்க மிருகம் உண்மையில் அபிஸ்ஸிலிருந்து ஏறிவந்தது.
events.description_en: On June 26, 1945, in San Francisco, 50 nations voted to accept the Charter of the United Nations organization. Jehovah’s Witnesses see in the UN the revival of the League of Nations, the image of the wild beast and “the disgusting thing that causes desolation.”
events.description_ta: ஜூன் 26, 1945-ல் அ.ஐ.மா., சான் ஃபிரான்ஸிஸ்கோவில், எக்காள முழக்க பேரொலியோடு ஐக்கிய நாட்டுச் சங்கத்தின் சாசனத்தை ஏற்றுக்கொள்ள 50 தேசங்கள் வாக்களித்தன.

sources.publication: Revelation—Its Grand Climax At Hand! (re) ch. 34
sources.title_en: An Awesome Mystery Solved
sources.quote_en: On June 26, 1945, with noisy fanfare in San Francisco, U.S.A., 50 nations voted to accept the Charter of the United Nations organization.

sources.title_en: Rival Kings in the Time of the End
sources.title_ta: கடைசி நாட்களில் எதிரும் புதிருமான இரண்டு ராஜாக்கள்
sources.quote_en: The United Nations is founded in 1945, replacing the League of Nations.

events.title_en: The United Nations (the image of the wild beast, “an eighth king”)
events.description_en: The United Nations, which replaced the League of Nations in 1945, is identified as “the image of the wild beast,” the scarlet-colored wild beast that is “an eighth king,” and “the disgusting thing that causes desolation.” It will be used to attack false religion.
events.description_ta: 1945-ல் சர்வதேச சங்கத்துக்குப் பதிலாக ஐ. நா. சபை ஏற்படுத்தப்பட்டது.

sources.publication: Revelation—Its Grand Climax At Hand! (re) ch. 34
sources.title_en: An Awesome Mystery Solved
sources.quote_en: On June 26, 1945, with noisy fanfare in San Francisco, U.S.A., 50 nations voted to accept the Charter of the United Nations organization.

sources.title_en: Revelation—What It Means for God’s Enemies
sources.quote_en: It existed first as the League of Nations. Then it went out of existence during World War II. It later emerged again in its present-day form.

sources.title_en: “The King of the North” in the Time of the End
sources.quote_en: That “disgusting thing” is the United Nations.

events.title_en: The Soviet Union and its allies become “the king of the north”
events.title_ta: 1945-ல் சோவியத் யூனியனும் அதன் கூட்டணிகளும் வடதிசை ராஜாவாக உருவெடுத்தன.
events.description_en: After World War II the Communist government of the Soviet Union took control of the vast territories it had captured from Germany and became the king of the north of Daniel 11.
events.description_ta: 1945-ல் சோவியத் யூனியனும் அதன் கூட்டணிகளும் வடதிசை ராஜாவாக உருவெடுத்தன.

sources.title_en: Rival Kings in the Time of the End
sources.title_ta: கடைசி நாட்களில் எதிரும் புதிருமான இரண்டு ராஜாக்கள்
sources.quote_en: In 1945 the Soviet Union and its allies become the king of the north.

sources.title_en: “The King of the North” in the Time of the End
sources.quote_en: After the second world war, the Communist government of the Soviet Union took control of the vast territories it had captured from Germany, and it became the king of the north.

events.title_en: The Soviet Union and its allies as “the king of the north”
events.title_ta: சோவியத் யூனியனும் அதன் கூட்டணி நாடுகளும் 1991 வரை வடதிசை ராஜாவாக இருந்தது.
events.description_en: From 1945 until its collapse in 1991 the Soviet Union and its allies filled the role of the king of the north: it banned the preaching work, exiled thousands of Witnesses, sought to eliminate religion and gave glory to “the god of fortresses” (Dan. 11:37-39).
events.description_ta: சோவியத் யூனியனும் அதன் கூட்டணி நாடுகளும் 1991 வரை வடதிசை ராஜாவாக இருந்தது.

sources.title_en: Rival Kings in the Time of the End
sources.title_ta: கடைசி நாட்களில் எதிரும் புதிருமான இரண்டு ராஜாக்கள்
sources.quote_en: In 1945 the Soviet Union and its allies become the king of the north.

sources.title_en: Rival Kings in the Time of the End
sources.title_ta: கடைசி நாட்களில் எதிரும் புதிருமான இரண்டு ராஜாக்கள்
sources.quote_en: The king of the north is identified as the Soviet Union and its allies until 1991, and thereafter as Russia and its allies.

sources.title_en: “The King of the North” in the Time of the End
sources.quote_en: The Soviet Union, with the goal of eliminating religion, tried to break the power of the traditional religious organizations.

events.notes: Pay Attention to Daniel’s Prophecy! (1999) ch. 16 chart: “Communist bloc (Cold War)” for Dan. 11:32-43.

events.title_en: The Soviet Union collapses; God’s people there enjoy “a little help”
events.description_en: The Soviet Union collapsed in 1991. God’s people in that vast region then enjoyed “a little help” (Dan. 11:34), a period of freedom in which they could preach freely.

sources.title_en: Rival Kings in the Time of the End
sources.title_ta: கடைசி நாட்களில் எதிரும் புதிருமான இரண்டு ராஜாக்கள்
sources.quote_en: In 1991, the Soviet Union collapses, and in time, Russia and its allies take over the role of the king of the north.

sources.title_en: Who Is “the King of the North” Today?
sources.quote_en: After the Soviet Union collapsed in 1991, God’s people in that vast region enjoyed “a little help”—a period of freedom.

events.title_en: Russia and its allies as “the king of the north”
events.title_ta: அதற்குப் பிறகு, ரஷ்யாவும் அதன் கூட்டணி நாடுகளும் வடதிசை ராஜாவாக ஆனது.
events.description_en: After the Soviet Union collapsed in 1991, Russia and its allies gradually emerged as the king of the north. They have banned the work of Jehovah’s people and compete with the king of the south, the Anglo-American World Power (Dan. 11:40-45).
events.description_ta: காலப்போக்கில், ரஷ்யாவும் அதன் கூட்டணிகளும் வடதிசை ராஜாவாக உருவெடுத்தன.

sources.title_en: Rival Kings in the Time of the End
sources.title_ta: கடைசி நாட்களில் எதிரும் புதிருமான இரண்டு ராஜாக்கள்
sources.quote_en: In 1991, the Soviet Union collapses, and in time, Russia and its allies take over the role of the king of the north.

sources.title_en: Who Is “the King of the North” Today?
sources.quote_en: Gradually, Russia and its allies emerged as the king of the north.

events.notes: jw.org gives no single start year: “in time” / “gradually” after the 1991 collapse; the Governing Body identified Russia and its allies as the king of the north in 2018 (b14-0015).

events.title_en: Governing Body identifies Russia and its allies as “the king of the north”
events.title_ta: இந்த நடவடிக்கைகளைப் பார்த்த பிறகு, ரஷ்யாவும் அதன் கூட்டணி நாடுகளும்தான் வடதிசை ராஜா என்பதை, 2018-ல் ஆளும் குழு உறுதி செய்தது.
events.description_en: After Russia banned the work of Jehovah’s Witnesses in 2017, imprisoned some of them and confiscated the branch office and Kingdom Halls, the Governing Body in 2018 identified Russia and its allies as the king of the north.
events.description_ta: இந்த நடவடிக்கைகளைப் பார்த்த பிறகு, ரஷ்யாவும் அதன் கூட்டணி நாடுகளும்தான் வடதிசை ராஜா என்பதை, 2018-ல் ஆளும் குழு உறுதி செய்தது.

sources.title_en: Who Is “the King of the North” Today?
sources.quote_en: After these actions, in 2018 the Governing Body identified Russia and its allies as the king of the north.
